CustomField.label: Requires Receipt
CustomField.description: Check on categories whose claim lines need a receipt. Mapped as the Category Requires Receipt Field in the Universal Budget configuration. Rows of checked categories show an attachment icon in place of the edit pencil on the claim sheet; the icon opens the same claim line form, where the file upload field belongs. Leave unchecked on ordinary categories.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check if every amount claimed in this category needs a receipt attached.
